children.text: pañcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ śayanāsanagrāhako bhikṣur asaṃmato na saṃmantavyaḥ, saṃmataś cāvakāśayitavyaḥ. katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ. chandād gacchati, dveṣān mohād bhayād gacchati, grāhitāgrāhitaṃ ca śayanāsanaṃ na jānāti. ebhiḥ pañcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ śayanāsanagrāhako bhikṣur asaṃmato na saṃmantavyaḥ, saṃmataś cāvakāśayitavyaḥ.
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is a lodging-assigner endowed with five qualities should not be appointed if not [previously] appointed, and if appointed should be removed. Which five? He acts out of partiality, he acts out of aversion, out of delusion, out of fear, and he does not know which lodgings have been assigned and which have not. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is a lodging-assigner endowed with these five qualities should not be appointed if not [previously] appointed, and if appointed should be removed.
Varṣāvastu section: 1.2.2.b

children.text: pañcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ śayanāsanagrāhako bhikṣur asaṃmataḥ saṃmantavyaḥ. saṃmataś ca nāvakāśayitavyaḥ. katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ. na chandād gacchati, na dveṣān na mohān na bhayād gacchati, grāhitāgrāhitaṃ ca śayanāsanaṃ jānāti. ebhiḥ pañcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataḥ śayanāsanagrāhako bhikṣur asaṃmataḥ saṃmantavyaḥ, saṃmataś ca nāvakāśayitavyaḥ.
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is a lodging-assigner endowed with five qualities should be appointed if not [previously] appointed, and if appointed should not be removed. Which five? He does not act out of partiality, he does not act out of aversion, not out of delusion, not out of fear, and he knows which lodgings have been assigned and which have not. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is a lodging-assigner endowed with these five qualities should be appointed if not [previously] appointed, and if appointed should not be removed.
Varṣāvastu section: 1.2.3
